lead_raw_text:
The structure of composition Tm8Zn4Ir4 (reduced formula Tm2ZnIr) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-42m (No. 194), with 16 atoms per unit cell across three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis gives Ir centers 10 geometric neighbors (4 Tm, 2 Ir, 4 Zn), Tm centers 12 neighbors (8 Tm, 4 Zn), and Zn centers 9 neighbors (4 Ir, 5 Tm). The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 16 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts show corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Ir and Tm polyhedra.
